Reference Notes & FAQ

What is PayPal's international transaction surcharge?

Receiving a commercial payment from a sender in another country typically adds a 1.50% cross-border fee, plus 3%–4% if currency conversion is required.

How can I calculate the exact invoice amount to receive $500 net?

Our calculator automatically displays the Reverse Gross-Up Invoice price right below your net result.
